title: Windows – Host load
description: Load of the Windows machine running WEBCON: CPU, memory, disks, network, processes, IIS (prometheus.exporter.windows in Alloy).

links.title: Documentation
links.tooltip: Panel descriptions and how to read them (GitHub)

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Average utilization of all cores (1 - idle).

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Physical memory in use (excluding reclaimable cache).

panels.title: Commit
panels.description: Committed memory (RAM + page file) relative to the limit. Close to 100% = risk of OutOfMemory.

panels.title: Processor queue
panels.description: Ready threads waiting for CPU. Consistently > 2 × number of cores = CPU shortage.

panels.title: Lowest free space
panels.description: Lowest free space percentage across volumes.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: System uptime.

panels.title: CPU utilization by mode
panels.description: Sum = CPU utilization. user = applications, privileged = kernel/drivers, interrupt/dpc = hardware handling.

panels.title: Utilization per core
panels.description: Uneven core utilization = single-threaded work or affinity.

panels.title: Processor queue
panels.description: Processor Queue Length.

panels.title: Context switches /s
panels.description: Sharp increase under steady load = lock contention / too many threads.

panels.title: Processes and threads
panels.description: Number of processes and threads in the system.

panels.title: Physical memory
panels.description: Available = free + standby (reclaimable cache).

panels.title: Commit vs limit
panels.description: Commit close to the limit = out of virtual memory (consider more RAM or a larger page file).

panels.title: Paging from disk (hard faults)
panels.description: Sustained page reads from disk = not enough RAM (the best memory pressure signal).

panels.title: Page faults / s
panels.description: All page faults (soft and hard).

panels.title: Kernel pools
panels.description: Steady growth of the nonpaged pool = driver leak.

panels.title: Disk usage
panels.description: Percentage of time the volume was servicing requests (100 - % Idle Time).

panels.title: Read / write latency
panels.description: Average operation time. SSD: < 5 ms good, > 20 ms problem. Critical for SQL Server.

panels.title: Disk queue
panels.description: Current Disk Queue Length.

panels.title: IOPS
panels.description: Operations per second.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second.

panels.title: Free space
panels.description: Free space percentage on volumes.

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Bits per second; dashed line (right axis) = adapter bandwidth utilization in %.

panels.title: Errors and discarded packets
panels.description: Should be 0.

panels.title: TCP
panels.description: Retransmissions (right axis, %) > 1% = network problems.

panels.title: CPU per process
panels.description: Process share of total CPU capacity (100% = all cores).

panels.title: Private memory (working set)
panels.description: Private working set – steady growth = memory leak.

panels.title: I/O per process
panels.description: Read + write + other I/O operations (disk and network).

panels.title: Handles
panels.description: Steady growth = handle leak.

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: Number of process threads.

panels.title: Requests /s
panels.description: All HTTP methods.

panels.title: Current connections
panels.description: Active connections to the site.

panels.title: Rejected async I/O requests /s
panels.description: Should be 0.
